ideas.children_he: אֱלֹהִים פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת דְּבָרָיו אֶל הָעָם. הַכָּתוּב מַקְדִּים שֶׁהוּא הַדּוֹבֵר אֶת כָּל הַדְּבָרִים הַבָּאִים.
ideas.children_en: God begins and declares all the words to the people. What can we learn from what happened here?

ideas.children_he: ה׳ מַזְכִּיר שֶׁהוֹצִיא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַבְדוּת. הוּא מְצַוֶּה שֶׁלֹּא יַעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים.
ideas.children_en: The Lord recalls delivering Israel from Egypt and commands them to have no other gods. What can we learn from what happened here?

ideas.children_he: אֵין לַעֲשׂוֹת פְּסָלִים לַעֲבוֹדָה וְאֵין לְהִשְׁתַּחֲווֹת לָהֶם. ה׳ עוֹשֶׂה חֶסֶד לְאוֹהֲבָיו וּלְשׁוֹמְרֵי מִצְווֹתָיו.
ideas.children_en: No idols may be made or worshiped; God judges those who hate Him and shows steadfast love to those who love and obey Him. What can we learn from what happened here?

ideas.children_he: אֵין לְהִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בְּשֵׁם ה׳ לַשָּׁוְא. יֵשׁ לִנְהֹג בִּשְׁמוֹ בְּכָבוֹד וּבֶאֱמֶת.
ideas.children_en: The Lord’s name must not be used falsely or carelessly; it is to be treated with reverence and truth. What can we learn from what happened here?

ideas.children_he: שֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַשָּׁבוּעַ נוֹעֲדוּ לַעֲבוֹדָה, וְשַׁבָּת לִמְנוּחָה. כָּל בְּנֵי הַבַּיִת וְגַם הַבְּהֵמוֹת שׁוֹבְתִים.
ideas.children_en: Work is done for six days, while the seventh is a holy rest for everyone, following God’s work of creation. What can we learn from what happened here?

ideas.children_he: יֵשׁ לְכַבֵּד אֶת הָאָב וְאֶת הָאֵם. לַמִּצְוָה נִלְוֵית הַבְטָחָה לַאֲרִיכוּת יָמִים בָּאָרֶץ.
ideas.children_en: The people are commanded to honor their father and mother so that their days may be long in the land God gives them. What can we learn from what happened here?

ideas.children_he: ה׳ אוֹסֵר רֶצַח, נִאוּף, גְּנֵבָה וְעֵדוּת שֶׁקֶר. הוּא אוֹסֵר גַּם לַחְמֹד אֶת מַה שֶּׁשַּׁיָּךְ לָאַחֵר.
ideas.children_en: Murder, adultery, theft, false testimony, and coveting anything belonging to another are forbidden. What can we learn from what happened here?

ideas.children_he: הָעָם פּוֹחֵד מֵהַקּוֹלוֹת וּמֵהָאֵשׁ וּמְבַקֵּשׁ שֶׁמֹּשֶׁה יְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו. מֹשֶׁה מִתְקָרֵב אֶל הֶעָרָפֶל שֶׁבּוֹ אֱלֹהִים.
ideas.children_en: The people witness thunder, flames, the trumpet, and the smoking mountain; they fear and ask Moses to speak for them, while Moses approaches the divine cloud. What can we learn from what happened here?

ideas.children_he: ה׳ מַזְכִּיר שֶׁדִּבֵּר מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם. הוּא מְצַוֶּה לֹא לַעֲשׂוֹת אֱלֹהֵי כֶסֶף וְזָהָב.
ideas.children_en: God reminds Israel that He spoke from heaven and commands them not to make gods of silver or gold. What can we learn from what happened here?

ideas.children_he: יֵשׁ לִבְנוֹת מִזְבֵּחַ פָּשׁוּט מֵאֲדָמָה אוֹ מֵאֲבָנִים שֶׁלֹּא סֻתְּתוּ בְּבַרְזֶל. אֵין לַעֲלוֹת אֵלָיו בְּמַדְרֵגוֹת.
ideas.children_en: The people are commanded to build an altar of earth or natural stones, offer sacrifices there, and avoid elaborate construction or exposed steps. What can we learn from what happened here?
